chunk:
deviations:
  - "Field names use camelCase (not OAGIS PascalCase) — DataWeave convention"
  - "orderId maps to OAGIS DocumentID/ID — simplified to flat string"
  - "customerId maps to OAGIS BuyerParty/PartyIDs/ID — not nested"
  - "status enum is canonical; OAGIS uses Status/Code with implementation-defined values"
  - "lines[] flattened from OAGIS Line[] with nested PurchaseOrderLineType"
  - "totals maps to OAGIS TotalAmount/Tax/ShippingAmount — renamed for clarity"

description: |
  Canonical order entity schema used across all client integrations.
  Source systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, Dynamics 365) map INTO this schema.
  Target systems map OUT OF this schema.
  DWL transforms handle the source→canonical and canonical→target conversions.
  OAGIS alignment: PurchaseOrderType — key fields orderId→DocumentID/ID,
  customerId→BuyerParty/PartyIDs/ID, lines→Line[], totals→TotalAmount/Tax/ShippingAmount.

required:
  - orderId
  - customerId
  - status
  - lines
  - totals
  - timestamps

properties:
  orderId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical order identifier (use source system ID; prefix with system name for cross-system uniqueness e.g. "SF-00601234")
    example: "SF-0060000001234"

  externalIds:
    type: object
    description: Source system identifiers — enables lookup from any system
    properties:
      salesforceOpportunityId: { type: string, example: "0060000001234" }
      netsuiteInternalId:      { type: string, example: "12345" }
      erpOrderNumber:          { type: string, example: "SO-2024-0001" }
      partnerOrderRef:         { type: string, example: "CUST-PO-9876" }

  customerId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical customer identifier (links to canonical-customer)
    example: "ACCT-001234"

  status:
    type: string
    enum: [DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, PROCESSING, FULFILLED, CANCELLED, CLOSED]
    description: Canonical order status — map source-system statuses to these values

  channel:
    type: string
    enum: [WEB, PHONE, EMAIL, EDI, PORTAL, API]
    description: How the order was placed

  lines:
    type: array
    minItems: 1
    items:
      $ref: '#/OrderLine'

  totals:
    $ref: '#/OrderTotals'

  fulfillment:
    $ref: '#/OrderFulfillment'

  billing:
    $ref: '#/BillingInfo'

  notes:
    type: string
    description: Internal notes — strip from customer-facing responses

  timestamps:
    $ref: '#/Timestamps'
